title: AI-assisted innovation request triage
problemOpportunity: Innovation requests arrive through several channels and often lack the detail reviewers need, creating repeated follow-up and inconsistent prioritisation.
proposedIdea: Provide an intake assistant that guides requesters through a structured conversation, captures a complete submission, and highlights missing evidence for reviewers.
expectedOutcome: Reduce clarification cycles while giving reviewers consistent information for discovery and prioritisation decisions.

businessContext.strategicAlignment: Improve the speed and quality of experimentation.
businessContext.currentProcess: Requesters complete a free-text form and reviewers manually request missing details by email.
businessContext.evidenceOfNeed: Reviewers report that most submissions require at least one clarification round.
businessContext.desiredTimeline: Run a limited pilot during the next planning quarter.

targetUsers.userNeeds: Requesters need clear guidance; reviewers need concise, comparable submissions.
targetUsers.accessibilityNeeds: The conversational flow and generated summary must support keyboard and screen-reader use.

successMeasures.timeframe: Within three months of the pilot

successMeasures.measure: Median time from submission to initial decision
successMeasures.timeframe: Within three months of the pilot

valueAndSuccess.costOfDoingNothing: Reviewers continue spending time collecting basic information instead of assessing and supporting promising ideas.
assumptions: Requesters can review and correct the structured summary before submission.

aiConsiderations.whyAI: A language model can ask context-aware follow-up questions and transform conversational answers into the agreed intake structure.
aiConsiderations.humanRole: The requester confirms the record before submission, and reviewers make every prioritisation decision.
aiConsiderations.acceptableFailure: The assistant may ask an unnecessary clarification question, but it must not invent request details or submit without confirmation.
aiConsiderations.nonAIAlternative: Replace the free-text form with a longer conditional web form.

sources.name: Requester responses
sources.description: Information entered during the intake conversation.

dataConsiderations.dataQuality: Free-text quality varies; the requester must confirm the generated record.
dataConsiderations.dataResidency: Use the organisation's approved regional services.
dataConsiderations.retentionRequirements: Align with the existing innovation request retention policy.

deliveryConsiderations.workCompleted: A small set of historical requests has been reviewed to identify common missing information.
constraints: Pilot data must remain in approved enterprise services
Existing review decisions must remain human-owned
deliveryConsiderations.budgetContext: Discovery funding is available; production funding depends on pilot evidence.

risks.description: A long conversation could discourage requesters.
risks.impact: Users may return to unstructured channels.
risks.mitigation: Keep only core fields compulsory and show progress throughout intake.

risks.description: The generated summary could misrepresent a requester's intent.
risks.mitigation: Require requester review and confirmation before submission.

responsibleAI.affectedStakeholders: Requesters and reviewers are directly affected; teams named in proposals may be indirectly affected.
responsibleAI.fairnessConsiderations: Guidance should not favour proposals based on writing style, role, or organisational seniority.
responsibleAI.transparencyNeeds: Users must know that AI drafts the record and that a human makes prioritisation decisions.
responsibleAI.humanOversight: Requesters approve submissions and reviewers retain decision authority.
potentialHarms: Important context could be omitted or distorted
Overconfident wording could make an early idea appear validated
harmMitigations: Show the source answer for each generated section

privacyRequirements: Collect only contact details needed for follow-up
Show a privacy notice before collection
regulatoryRequirements: Complete the organisation's privacy and responsible-AI reviews before pilot launch
securityAndPrivacy.reviewNotes: Detailed review is still required because request descriptions may include personal or commercially sensitive information.

additionalNotes: Start with a small reviewer group and use pilot feedback to refine optional questions.
